text.p: Bre-X Minerals Ltd shot up in heavy trading in yet another bout of rumors Tuesday afternoon.
The stock rose C$1.60 to C$22.10 in trading of more than 2.5 million shares.
Rumors that Bre-X would have something to say later in the day were spreading quickly through the market, analysts said.
"It's the heaviest rumors I've heard so far," said one analyst. "It's rocking and rolling here."
Bre-X denied the rumors. A spokesman said he had no knowledge of any announcement expected later Tuesday.
Bre-X stock has been volatile since a dispute over the ownership of its giant Busang gold deposit in Indonesia arose earlier this fall.
One of the company's Indonesian partners has threatened to sue Bre-X in Canadian courts unless the dispute is settled before this Friday.
The dispute has cast a cloud over Bre-X's search for a major gold producer to act as an operator or owner of the deposit.
